prompt: A nighttime scene set in 1980s New York City, where an elliptical UFO hovers silently above the skyscrapers. The city is bathed in dim, neon lights, with a few streets illuminated by flickering streetlamps and glowing signs. The UFO, metallic and sleek, emits a faint, eerie light as it floats in the sky, casting long shadows across the streets below. The skyline is a mix of towering buildings and fire escapes, with the dark sky above filled with faint stars and low-hanging clouds. The atmosphere is mysterious and tense, as the quiet of the late hour contrasts with the surreal presence of the hovering spacecraft. The scene captures the eerie and otherworldly nature of a UFO sighting in the heart of New York. --ar 9:16 --v 6.1
